parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description:
The end of the time range to query. The following formats are supported:

*   UNIX timestamp: the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since 00:00:00 UTC on Thursday, January 1, 1970.
*   UTC time: the UTC time that follows the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ format.

parameters.name: Length
parameters.description: The number of data points to return.

parameters.name: MetricName
parameters.description:
The metric name. Valid values:

*   Availability
*   ResponseTime

parameters.name: Period
parameters.description:
The statistical period. The value is an integral multiple of 60. Unit: seconds.

>  The default value equals the minimum interval at which detection requests are sent to the monitored address.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description:
The start of the time range to query. The following formats are supported:

*   UNIX timestamp: the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since 00:00:00 UTC on Thursday, January 1, 1970.
*   UTC time: the UTC time that follows the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ format.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The type of the monitored object whose monitoring data is to be queried. Valid values:

*   metric
*   event

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cms describe-site-monitor-data --task-id 49f7b317-7645-4cc9-94fd-ea42e5220000 --type metric --metric-name Availability --start-time 1551579637000 --end-time 1551581437000 --period 60 --next-token 49f7b317-7645-4cc9-94fd-ea42e5220930ea42e5220930ea42e5220000 --length 1000 --api-version 2019-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
